adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered GK37 activity/toxicity rows from main text, Figure 6, and the ZIP-contained supplementary PDF, reconciled linked DBAASP rows, preserved two database conflicts, and closed the prior targeted rework ticket with cautions rather than a clean acceptance.

materials_exhausted.note: Primary XML/PDF, extracted PDF text, OA package member images, ZIP-contained supplementary PDF, and linked DBAASP JSONL rows were opened. Remaining limitations are preserved as cautions rather than open rework.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP literature and source-supported assay rows were reconciled to GK37 primary-paper locators. The HEK293T cell-death row and plasma MIC unit conflict are preserved as source_conflict, not source_verified.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Activity/toxicity rows are now present for MIC, inhibition zones, biofilm activity, hemolysis, cytotoxicity, plasma stability, and killing kinetics with units, targets, conditions, and locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Membrane perturbation is accepted with caution from SEM/TEM and SYTO9/PI evidence; source discussion does not exclude other mechanisms.
per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains structurally complete-with-gaps because the supplement index missed the ZIP-contained PDF, but bounded worker review recovered and checked the relevant local supplement tables.
